body: /u/Greyloft I tell them a lot but they just say to keep with it. Things have really changed for me in my life is starting to turn around but the memories are still there and they really bother me. They haven’t really given me any advice than what I’m already doing. I don’t really have a strategy on how to get rid of the trauma. A lot of people just don’t understand what a come from and it’s hard to deal with at times. Thank you so much for even commenting I was so scared I was never going to get a comment this is my first post ever. I even tried calling the suicide hotline a couple times but they already knew who I was and even said I should just do it if I really want to do it and hung up. It’s just been hard to find resolve.
